problem.experience: The work happens in theOS, but what is released, what the box holds and what aven.maia.city serves are defined by avenDB, a legacy project theOS must not change. theOS can neither test in a box of its own nor ship.

items.text: avensandbox.yml released avenOS, avenSANDBOX and avenPEER from production, each under a dated version; the last release is #1750 (avenOS 26.10.31v6, avenPEER 26.10.31v5, avenSANDBOX 26.10.31v2).
avensandbox-image.yml and avenpeer-image.yml built their images from aven/DB2's Cargo workspace.
avendeploy.yml deployed the Aven Peer and avenOS at aven.maia.city, by hand.
aven/DB2/sandbox/box/Dockerfile compiles avenDB's third-party crates; cloud-setup.sh runs avenDB's `bun run up`, four avenDB peers.
The environment's setup script looks only for aven/DB2/sandbox/box/cloud-setup.sh, and exits 0 when it is not there (aven/DB2/SANDBOX.md, "Samuel's part").

problem.baseline: Before the park: four workflows, all avenDB's. theOS has no box, no workflow and no release of its own.
whys: theOS cannot test in its own box or ship. Why? The box and the pipeline build, test and release avenDB.
Why? They were built for avenDB (29 to 31 Oct) before theOS became the standalone project (D-4).
Root cause: the release pipeline and the sandbox belong to a legacy project.
truths: GitHub runs only the files in .github/workflows/; a file moved out of it never runs.
A deployed server keeps serving what it was last given until something deploys again.
An image already published to a registry stays pullable when its workflow stops.
The environment's setup script never fails a session: it exits 0 when it finds no setup file.
A workflow file must live in .github/workflows/; what it runs can live in theOS/.
assumptions: Nothing depends on a new avenDB release; aven.maia.city may stay as it is until theOS releases.
theOS's checks need only bun, Chromium and Playwright now; Lean, Rust and the vectors join when an AIP needs them.
problem.risk: High: the release path and a production server. The park stops releases, image builds and deploys; it removes nothing that is live.

reuse.use: Learned from: production takes changes from main only; one release per changed package, under the date (26.10.29, 26.10.29v2, ...); a push that changes nothing releases nothing.
Learned from: the image is tagged by the hash of the files its build reads, so every checkout runs exactly its own box; built per architecture, then joined.

reuse.what: aven/DB2/sandbox/box/cloud-setup.sh and the environment's setup script
reuse.use: Learned from: warm the box once, before the disk is snapshotted; never fail a session.
Learned from: run by hand in the environment production; health checks after the deploy; nothing secret printed, the repository is public.

options.note: Ownership moves at once (D-24); theOS's box and release grow in checkpoints, smallest first.

claims.promise: Once the park reaches main, no avenDB workflow runs, and nothing live changes: aven.maia.city serves the same avenOS release, and the box and peer images stay pullable.
claims.fails: A parked workflow still runs, or the park takes something down.
claims.check: After the merge: none of the four is among GitHub's active workflows; aven.maia.city answers with avenOS 26.10.31v6; a new cloud session starts.

claims.promise: theOS's box is one image built only from theOS/sandbox/box/, tagged by the hash of its inputs, and theOS's check command (AIP-1) runs green inside it.
claims.fails: The box needs files outside theOS/, or the check passes outside the box and fails in it.
claims.check: Build it from a checkout that holds only theOS/; run the check inside it.

claims.promise: A new cloud session warms theOS's box, and a session whose warm-up fails still starts.
claims.fails: A setup error stops every new session before Claude starts.
claims.check: The environment's setup script finds theOS/sandbox/box/cloud-setup.sh; with a failure planted in it, the script still exits 0 and a new session starts.

claims.promise: theOS releases from production only, under a dated version, and only when something it ships changed.
claims.fails: A release from a branch other than main, or a release with nothing in it.
claims.check: A pull request into production from another branch fails; a push that changes nothing theOS ships releases nothing.

outcome.promise: theOS is the one authority: every release and box image comes from files in theOS/, and no avenDB workflow runs.
outcome.how: Read off GitHub's active workflows and the releases' tags.

checkpoints.adds: avenDB's four workflows parked in .github/workflows-avendb/, with a README and a note atop the repository's CLAUDE.md. Done at your direct ask (D-24).
theOS/sandbox/box/: its Dockerfile, its tag, cloud-setup.sh, and its image workflow; the environment's new setup script, for you to paste.
